description: v0.208.0. One printing place: which job types it prints, on what media, and what its agent last reported. ROUTING IS DATA — moving asset tags to a label printer is a second row here and a second agent config, not a code change. docs/design/card_print_queue.md §2.3.

fields.label: Station Name
fields.description: The name the agent's config carries, e.g. primacy2-main.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Lower wins when several stations print the same job type.

fields.label: Job Types
fields.description: One per line: Employee ID, Asset Tag.

fields.label: Companies
fields.description: Optional, one per line. Empty means every company.

fields.label: Media
fields.description: For people: e.g. CR80 PVC card 85.6 x 54 mm.

fields.label: Duplex
fields.description: v0.209.0. Simplex: a two-sided card prints its front, and the back on request after a manual flip. Duplex: one job, both sides — set this once dual-side printing is enabled in the Evolis software.

fields.label: Front Orientation
fields.options:
Landscape
Portrait, rotated CW
Portrait, rotated CCW
fields.description: v0.209.0. The front is designed landscape. Choose a rotated value if the driver needs the page turned.

fields.label: Back Orientation
fields.options:
Portrait
Landscape, rotated CW
Landscape, rotated CCW
fields.description: The back is designed portrait and is turned onto a landscape page by default (v0.209.2), which is what the Primacy 2 prints correctly. Portrait sends it as a 54 x 85.6 mm page.

name: Card Print Station
